title: Research construction: phase-typed two-source order-four echo (no new kappa)
body:
## Status

Research construction; no new κ and no selected-frontier change.

## Result

For the pinned order-four, five-child interface, this package checks two independent 24-coordinate source banks `X,Y` with arbitrary dirty `D` and a restored workspace. The exact map is `D -> D + Σ_{i=0..4} R_i X + Σ_{i=5..9} R_i Y`.

The phase-indexed child type is `C_(i,t)(D,W)=(D+Q^(-t)R_i W, P W)`, with `Q^(-t)R_iP^t=R_i`. At the fixed 5|5 split, the source-bank handoff is `W += P^3(Y-X)`, charged at 48 ADDs. Exhaustive recurrence checks cover all `4^5=1,024` and `4^10=1,048,576` phase paths, and both complete maps replay on all 80 basis columns.

The typed calls cost 1,696 primitives separately and 1,552 jointly (144 saved; 288 fewer reads). A distinct unchanged-reader control costs 2,016 separately and 1,952 jointly (64 saved). Five negative controls reject omitted or mistyped handoff, omitted restoration, and omitted literal inverse. These are exact costs in the declared signed-ADD word model; supplier routing, tape/hosting, fixed-precision admission, and transfer into the selected recursive supplier remain unproved.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/z4-distinct-source-seed55
```

Expected result includes:

```text
PASS_Z4_DISTINCT_SOURCE_PHASE_TYPED_ECHO g5=60 g10=48 separate=1696 joint=1552 saved=144 reads_saved=288 paths=1024+1048576 basis=80 controls=5
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/z4-distinct-source-seed55 outcome=completed
```
